title: Substrate-Specific Inactivation of Human AAG by Tumor-Associated Single Nucleotide Polymorphic Variants.
authors: Kladova, Olga A; Tyugashev, Timofey E; Bakman, Artemiy S; Kuznetsova, Aleksandra A
one_liner_zh: 该文通过生化实验和MD模拟研究人AAG糖基化酶SNP突变体对DNA底物特异性的影响，属于广义蛋白-DNA互作且采用物理模拟方法，但对象非TF-DNA体系，故评5分。
abstract: Human alkyladenine DNA glycosylase (AAG) initiates base excision repair of various alkylated and deaminated purines. Single nucleotide polymorphisms (SNPs) in the AAG gene occur frequently in populations and tumors, but the functional impact of most variants remains unknown. Previously, we identified three SNPs-P94L, V158M, and E293K-which have been predicted to have a high deleterious potential. This study aimed to characterize their biochemical properties and structural consequences. Using a combination of biochemical assays and molecular dynamics simulations, we assessed the thermal stability, DNA binding affinity, and catalytic activity of these mutants on two structurally distinct substrates: 1, N(6)-ethenoadenosine (epsilonA) and hypoxanthine (Hx). All three mutants exhibited reduced melting temperatures, indicating pronounced destabilization. Despite this, their DNA-binding affinities remained close to WT AAG. Strikingly, the mutants displayed differential loss of catalytic activity: P94L was inactive against both epsilonA and Hx; V158M retained activity against epsilonA but lost activity against Hx; and E293K was active against Hx but inactive against epsilonA. MD simulations revealed that P94L alters the flexible R138-T143 loop, V158M narrows the active site cleft, and E293K disrupts a C-terminal salt bridge while increasing DNA engagement by the positively charged tail. These findings demonstrate that non-active-site SNPs can qualitatively reprogram the substrate specificity of AAG. These variants could be considered as potential functional biomarkers for cancer risk and response to alkylating chemotherapy.
abstract_zh: 人源烷基腺嘌呤DNA糖基化酶（AAG）启动多种烷基化和脱氨基嘌呤的碱基切除修复。AAG基因中的单核苷酸多态性（SNPs）在人群和肿瘤中频繁发生，但大多数变异的功能影响仍未知。此前，我们鉴定了三个SNPs——P94L、V158M和E293K——这些变异被预测具有较高的有害潜力。本研究旨在表征其生化特性和结构后果。通过结合生化实验和分子动力学模拟，我们评估了这些突变体在两种结构不同的底物——1,N(6)-乙烯腺苷（epsilonA）和次黄嘌呤（Hx）——上的热稳定性、DNA结合亲和力和催化活性。所有三个突变体均表现出降低的熔解温度，表明显著的去稳定化。尽管如此，它们的DNA结合亲和力仍接近野生型AAG。引人注目的是，突变体表现出差异性的催化活性丧失：P94L对epsilonA和Hx均无活性；V158M保留了对epsilonA的活性但丧失了对Hx的活性；而E293K对Hx有活性但对epsilonA无活性。分子动力学模拟揭示，P94L改变了灵活的R138-T143环，V158M收窄了活性位点裂隙，E293K破坏了C端盐桥，同时增加了带正电尾部对DNA的参与。这些发现表明，非活性位点SNPs可以定性重编程AAG的底物特异性。这些变异可被视为癌症风险和烷基化化疗反应的潜在功能性生物标志物。
